title: A plan whose proof is a video suggests a length that fits the step
origin: Issue #163 (More ways to send proof): Should, when the proof is a video, the plan suggests a length that fits the step

answers.tracks_with: nothing yet, I'd just film myself

history.text: I'd probably just film myself on my phone
Filming works great for juggling. Is there a point you want to get to?

testerLines: a clean cascade for a full minute would be amazing. weekdays work

testerLines.when: after ZOH shows the plan and asks what they think
after ZOH asks for their commitment (if they're in)

facts: you practice in your living room at 6 pm, about 15 minutes
you can keep the cascade going for a few seconds now
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: video proof needs a length, or people send nothing or ten minutes.
shouldHaveHappened: The plan's proof is a short video of the practice with a length that fits (about a minute or two, for example their best run), with a one-line why and an easy alternative; never typed text. After 'looks good' it asks for the commitment naturally; after 'I'm in' it locks with a hype line and when day 1 is.
